face.name: 石头穴居人
face.text: 战吼：对一个随从造成6点伤害。如果该随从依然存活， 本随从获得+6生命值和嘲讽。
face.flavorText: 生动诠释了什么叫“一次不行，再试一次”。

face.name: Stone Trogg
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to a minion. If it survives, gain +6 Health and Taunt.
face.flavorText: Literal embodiment of "If at first you don't succeed, try, try again."

face.name: 拉特维亚护甲师
face.text: 战吼：对一个敌方随从造成2点伤害。如果该随从死亡，&获得5点护甲值。
face.flavorText: 现在只需要给龟壳喷上一层蓝漆！

face.name: Latorvian Armorer
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies,& gain 5 Armor.
face.flavorText: All it needs now is a nice coat of blue paint!

face.name: 锈烂蝰蛇
face.text: 可交易。战吼：&摧毁对手的武器。
face.flavorText: 这也是剧毒，针对武器的剧毒。

face.name: 蒸汽清洁器
face.text: 战吼：摧毁双方玩家牌库中所有套牌之外的牌。
face.flavorText: 自从心能短缺，工作清闲了下来。地上迸溅的心能少多了！

face.name: Steamcleaner
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
face.flavorText: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!

face.name: 火羽凤凰
face.flavorText: 凤凰本非凡俗鸟，浴火重生凌云霄。

face.name: Fire Plume Phoenix
face.flavorText: This is what happens when you use a volcano as a bird bath.

face.name: 战场通灵师
face.text: 在你的回合结束时，&将一份残骸复活为1/3并具有嘲讽的复活的步兵。
face.flavorText: 敬请期待：手牌通灵师和牌库通灵师。

face.name: Battlefield Necromancer
face.text: At the end of your turn,& raise a Corpse as a 1/3 Risen Footman with Taunt.
face.flavorText: Coming soon: the Hand Necromancer and the Deck Necromancer.

policies: Original health callbacks determine survival and actual death, not damage arithmetic
Native prefix retains its minion/enemy target declaration
Existing target-bearing character suffix is restricted by the native prefix
Original whole source is preserved on self composition; no external source authentication for unsigned saves
